corrections.text: The sword I'm about to forge will resemble your old one, but it will be something different.
corrections.reason: Source contrasts new sword with previous one: similar but different, not unprecedented in history.

corrections.text: Don't worry. I'll stay right beside him and keep an eye on him.
corrections.reason: Pupil stays with Vizel while Teacher leaves to find an answer; watch target is smith, not departing Teacher.

uncertainties.note: Object of keeping watch is Vizel, inferred from pupil remaining to help repair sword while Teacher leaves. Parallel Belfraw variant confirms distrust.
